/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- tsconfig.json package.json .gitignore app/page.tsx next.config.ts && git status --short'

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from subprocess import check_output
original = check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:tsconfig.json'], text=True)
updated = original.replace('\"jsx\": \"preserve\"', '\"jsx\": \"react-jsx\"')
updated = updated.replace('\".next/types/**/*.ts\"]', '\".next/types/**/*.ts\", \".next/dev/types/**/*.ts\"]')
Path('tsconfig.json').write_text(updated)
PY"
